latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — introduces a complete, step-by-step lead nurture system builder for small businesses.

- Guides users through inventorying their current follow-up process and identifying gaps.
- Helps select or confirm the right CRM platform to power automations.
- Designs a value-first 5-part, 30-day email nurture sequence.
- Plans a "shock and awe" package for inbound lead engagement.
- Builds a full marketing calendar (daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly/annual cadence).
- Maps event triggers to automated responses and clarifies role assignments.
- Produces a ready-to-implement nurture-sequence.md document with all components.
